Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Email & CRM Marketing Specialist role at your partner company, as listed on Jobgether. With a technical background in digital marketing and hands-on experience in campaign execution, segmentation, and automation, I'm excited about the opportunity to drive customer engagement and retention for B2C audiences.

In my current roles, I manage multi-channel campaigns and use data to personalize communication. At Episto, I handle SEO content and CMS management for client websites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. As a freelancer, I built and optimized websites with structured data and automated workflows, including a site-check enquiry flow. I'm proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I regularly use AI tools to improve efficiency. While I haven't worked in iGaming, my experience with customer segmentation, A/B testing, and deliverability best practices aligns well with your requirements.

I'm eager to bring my skills to your collaborative team and contribute to innovative CRM strategies. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Email & CRM Marketing Specialist position at your partner company, as advertised on Jobgether. With a solid foundation in digital marketing and a technical edge, I am eager to contribute to your CRM team and help drive customer engagement, retention, and loyalty.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to track performance. I also handle CMS content management, ensuring that messaging is consistent and up-to-date. As a freelancer, I have built and optimized websites from the ground up, implementing structured data and automated workflows that enhance user experience. My technical skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, combined with my daily use of AI tools, enable me to execute and optimize campaigns efficiently.

While my experience has primarily focused on SEO and content, I have a strong understanding of customer segmentation, A/B testing, and performance metrics. I have applied these principles in various projects, such as creating targeted landing pages and analyzing campaign data to improve conversion rates. I am confident that my analytical mindset and collaborative approach will allow me to quickly adapt to Customer.io and contribute to your multi-channel campaigns.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the emphasis on experimentation and innovation. I thrive in environments where I can test new ideas and learn from data. I am excited about the opportunity to work with an international team and to further develop my skills in lifecycle marketing and deliverability management.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with experience in front-end development and technical SEO.
• Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs for performance tracking and reporting.
• Skilled in CMS management (WordPress, Elementor) and content creation for client websites.
• Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content, and automation.
• Strong analytical skills, with experience in A/B testing and campaign optimization.
